logp.method_description: Each Ru complex was first dissolved in DMSO and then diluted using phosphate-buffered saline (PBS, pH 7.4) to achieve a 50 μM solution containing 1% DMSO. The absorbance of the resultant aqueous solution was measured; then an equal volume of 1-octanol was added, and the two phases were mixed using an IKA Trayster digital mixer for 30 min at 60 rpm under ambient conditions. After being mixed, the samples were briefly centrifuged (3 min, 2200g); then the aqueous layer was carefully removed, and its absorbance spectrum was measured. The log D7.4 value was then calculated using the equation log D7.4 = log((Abs at λmax before mixing / Abs at λmax after mixing) - 1)
